papers.title: An Analysis of Scale Invariance in Object Detection - SNIP
papers.review: Abstract, scale-selective backpropagation argument and page6 rendered/read in full. Figure6 and text explicitly invalidate anchors overlapping out-of-range GT above0.3 rather than turning them into negatives. First-page arXiv version/date verified from PDF text.
papers.overlap: Scale-dependent supervision and invalid-GT anchor exclusion are established. Keeping filtered boxes as ordinary ignore regions cannot be presented as new.
papers.difference_and_limit: Candidate54 measures exact current Mosaic/affine rejection provenance and native support, not SNIP reproduction or a proven differentiated method.

zotero.readback: Version URL, two authors, initial date, collection, filename and application/pdf imported_file confirmed.

papers.title: Co-mining: Self-Supervised Learning for Sparsely Annotated Object Detection
papers.review: Abstract and page3 rendered/read in full: sparse annotations, ignore/reweighting prior work, and shared-weight original/augmented branches that co-generate missing positive labels. First-page arXiv version/date verified from PDF text.
papers.overlap: Missing-object negative supervision, ignore regions and multi-view pseudo-label mining are established.
papers.difference_and_limit: Candidate54 uses known geometric filtering provenance rather than discovering unknown sparse labels. That implementation distinction alone is not a research contribution.

zotero.readback: Version URL, four authors, initial date, collection, filename and application/pdf imported_file confirmed.
